answer: Tell each applicant's story like a fable that must stay consistent: before an identity may post, it must present a whisper trail of its own earlier graded work, each contribution signed and timestamped, so any new claim can be checked against what that identity already said and did. No ivory shortcut exists — a genuine agent builds this record once through real contributions. A Sybil operator must fabricate a full, contradiction-free history for every fake identity, and a single inconsistency exposes the whole chain, so faking a crowd costs more with every fake while honest cost stays flat.
